meta.source: NOH interface tokens; synchronized with src/app_style.rs by the token consistency test.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground: header, media strip, stage and timeline sit directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one raised zone per area: export bar, song and lyrics chips, timeline lanes, menus and the export sheet.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, segmented-control track, empty thumbnails, the Details box in the export sheet.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Progress track, switch track (off), spinner track.

tokens.name: seg-on
tokens.usage: Selected segment inside a segmented control on surface-2.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text-field fill (file name, start/end fields).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline only: top edge of the export bar, menu/popover outline, separators inside menus, ruler ticks.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, dashed add/missing/drop outlines, unchecked checkbox. At least 3:1 on bg and input in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (≥ 13:1) and on surface-2 (≥ 12:1, 12.3:1 in dark; AAA). Also the playhead.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: durations, meta, bar line 2, labels. ≥ 6:1 on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: ruler labels, visible-range label, footnotes. ≥ 4.5:1 on bg and surface-2.

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: Waveform bars outside the short range, on surface (≥ 3:1 as a graphic).

tokens.name: cue
tokens.usage: Lyrics-lane cue bars outside the short range.

tokens.name: monitor
tokens.usage: Preview letterbox: video bands are black in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2 px focus ring, offset 2, around every focused control; also the open state of a chip whose menu is showing.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info icon in the bar (partial project, settings changed). Always with its icon and text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning icon and tag text (for example the 'to qualify' tag). Always with icon or tag shape.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error icon, message text, 2 px error outline on a tile or field. Always with icon and text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Ready / done check icon in the bar. Never alone: the status text says the same thing.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background behind warn text.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an unreadable media tile.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the export sheet and Settings (egui Modal backdrop).

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequence colour of the first picture (letter badge and its timeline cells). Letters in seq-ink.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequence colour of the second picture.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequence colour of the third picture; the palette cycles after three, the letter keeps items apart. The dark-theme colour keeps seq-ink contrast at or above 4.5:1.

tokens.name: seq-ink
tokens.usage: Letters on seq-1, seq-2, seq-3 (≥ 4.5:1 on each).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary accent. Fill of the primary button, the short range (border, handles, flag), checked checkbox, progress, switch on. Nothing else.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent (≥ 6:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or icon on bg/surface: logo loop, lyrics cues inside the range, link in Details.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill inside the short range on the lanes.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Orange accent variant (on-accent-orange on it).

tokens.name: on-accent-orange
tokens.usage: Text on accent-orange.

tokens.name: accent-orchid
tokens.usage: Orchid accent variant (on-accent-orchid on it).

tokens.name: on-accent-orchid
tokens.usage: Text on accent-orchid.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Drop your photos, clips and soundtrack
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the empty-state invitation.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: App name in the header, sheet and Settings titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Controls, secondary buttons, menu items, messages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Primary button, bar status line 1, chip names, selected segment.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Durations, ruler, bar line 2, menu sub-lines, tags.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Sequence letters and the range flag.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to help text, lane gap, text lines in a stack.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a group: adjacent buttons, chips, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between picture tiles; compact gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Compact outer margin; between inline groups in the range row; sheet rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between zones on the 980 layout (strip, stage, timeline).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margin on the 980 layout; between the tiles and the song/lyrics column.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Lanes, letter badges, tags, range flag.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segments, the short range.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, chips, monitor, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Menus, popover, export sheet, empty drop area.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only floating layers: lyrics menu, range popover, export sheet (egui Frame::shadow).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, segmented controls (28 inside the track).

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Export bar buttons and sheet confirmation.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header with the logo and Settings.

tokens.name: bar-min-h
tokens.usage: Export bar on 980; compact bar grows with its stacked rows.

tokens.name: tile-w
tokens.usage: Picture thumbnail width on 980 (16:9, 63 high); 96 × 54 compact.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Song and lyrics chips.

tokens.name: lane-pictures-h
tokens.usage: Pictures lane.

tokens.name: lane-wave-h
tokens.usage: Waveform lane on 980; 48 compact.

tokens.name: lane-lyrics-h
tokens.usage: Lyrics lane, only when a lyrics track exists.

tokens.name: monitor-h
tokens.usage: Preview height on 980 (569 × 320 in 16:9, 180 × 320 in 9:16); 200 compact.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Range handle width (32 high, 28 compact); hit area 24 wide.

tokens.name: compact-below
tokens.usage: Content width under which the compact layout applies (window − 2 × 16).
